Our Process

From Your Idea to Your Space

Simple steps with direct communication throughout.

01 • Understand

Discuss your needs, room, style and budget with Harish Bhai.

02 • Measure

Plan around actual dimensions and practical usage.

03 • Plan

Confirm layout, materials, finishes and useful storage.

04 • Build

Custom furniture is produced with attention to finishing.

05 • Install

Delivery and professional installation complete the project.

FAQ

Common Questions

Do you make custom furniture?

Yes. Satguru SG focuses on custom-made furniture and interior work based on the customer's space and requirements.

Can I request a modular kitchen or wardrobe?

Yes. You can discuss your measurements, storage needs, materials and finish directly over WhatsApp or during a site visit.

How do I book a site visit?

Use the booking form above. It prepares a WhatsApp enquiry with your details for direct communication.

Can I see your real completed projects?

Yes. The best portfolio is your own completed-project photography. You can send your real photos and they can be organized by category.
